results.text: Effect of nebivolol on erectile function: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Historically, β-blockers have been associated with erectile dysfunction (ED). Nebivolol, a third-generation β-blocker, may have had no negative effect on erectile function because of its vasodilating properties.
